blurb: Guests can enjoy whale watching tours with naturalist guides, dinner cruises, brunch cruises, and sightseeing cruises on the St. Lawrence River. Whale watching tours include access to a VIP lounge with gourmet food and bar service. Cruises operate in multiple locations including Montreal, Tadoussac, and Charlevoix, with a focus on eco-responsibility and passenger safety.
